text:
If you were waiting on a green light for the afternoon, here it is: Friday's holding exactly to plan, clear and comfortable, sitting at 72 with light north wind and no signs of anything sneaking in. That sunshine sticks around through the day, with the high topping out near 78, and the models are all in agreement there's zero rain to worry about today. The lake's calm too, waves a foot or less and water sitting at a swimmable 72, so if you've got waterfront plans this evening, they're a go.

Looking ahead, tonight stays mostly clear and comfortable with a low near 55, good sleeping weather with the windows open. Saturday keeps the good stuff going early, sunny to start with a high near 81, but the forecasters are watching clouds build in by afternoon and evening. Get your outdoor plans in on the front half of the day. Enjoy this stretch, showers are on the way late Saturday into Sunday.

week.blurb: Sunny and pleasant with a high near 78, one of the best days of the stretch.
Saturday starts sunny then clouds roll in by afternoon, high near 81.
Showers and thunderstorms move in after 2pm Sunday, some potentially strong with hail and gusty winds, high near 81.
Showers and storms return Monday afternoon, high near 77, with a coin-flip chance of rain.
Tuesday trends drier with just a slim chance of showers, high near 76.
Wednesday looks mostly sunny and pleasant, high near 81, with just an overnight shower chance.
Thursday trends toward afternoon showers and storms, high near 82, with roughly a one-in-three chance of rain.

WCAX METEOROLOGIST: The weekend forecast is a bit of a mixed bag. Saturday looks to be the nicer of the two weekend days, with a good deal of sunshine especially to start the day, but we look to fade into more cloud cover by later Saturday afternoon and evening. High temperatures for the day are in the 70s to about 80. We start Sunday with clouds and scattered showers, but we will run the chance for a few thunderstorms into Sunday afternoon. There is the chance for a thunderstorm or two to be on the strong to severe side, with heavy rain, gusty winds and possibly some small hail. Temperatures are in the 70s for the day.
